items.title: MORE EVIDENCE THAT THE COMMODITY PRICE SUPER CYCLE IS IN GEAR. STAY LONG COPPER.
items.content:
MORE EVIDENCE THAT THE COMMODITY PRICE SUPER CYCLE IS IN GEAR. 

STAY LONG COPPER. 

 x.com/mining/status/20951762… MINING.COM (@mining)Only six major copper discoveries have been made worldwide since 2020, totaling 8.8 million tonnes, even as exploration budgets rose to $3.3B in 2025.

Grassroots exploration has fallen to a historic low share of spending. Instead of finding new deposits, companies are pouring budgets into brownfield expansions on mines they already have.

The largest deposit driving recent growth, Filo del Sol, was discovered in 2000.

Primary mine output is expected to peak around 2030. New mines take 15 to 20 years to build.

Source: S&P Global Market Intelligence—  https://x.com/mining/status/2095176250947961126 
— Steve Hanke (@steve_hanke) Sep 2, 2026
